title: Maintenance.
officialText:
The building owner shall maintain postfire smoke exhaust systems in good operational condition. Records of
testing shall be maintained on the premises for inspection by the department and Fire Department personnel.
SECTION BC 917
FIRE DEPARTMENT IN-BUILDING AUXILIARY RADIO COMMUNICATION SYSTEM (ARCS)
